title: API access
snippet: The API access feature is included in the enterprise plan or plans above that. If you are in the basic plan or the pro plan, you will need to pay an additional $50 per month to buy this feature separately.

title: Technology Partner Program | Intercom
snippet:
01
### Technology Partner
Dedicated app reports, early access to APIs, eligible for inclusion in our New & Noteworthy collection, and more.
[See full benefits list](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/68yer78tmakt3098yezg3/Intercom-App-Partner-Program-Overview.pdf?rlkey=mtyin47mwk913r2w35nm0eum8&e=1&dl=0)

Any company with an app in the Intercom App Store can join as long as it meets our app and listing guidelines, has a Start Guide, and completes the Technology Partner Program details section.
